top_categories.workout_context: At mile 60 of 100, glycogen is gone. This workout teaches your body to produce watts on fumes.
Race-pace efforts that mimic Best Buddies Challenge: Miami's demands. Pacing, fueling, and tactical decisions under fatigue. Practice the race before November.
Best Buddies Challenge: Miami's flat urban/coastal roads forces constant power changes. Accelerate over rises and out of corners, settle on the open road, and repeat for 100 miles.
Every hard session works better with a bigger aerobic base. At 100 miles, base fitness is the difference between racing and surviving.
Best Buddies Challenge: Miami's flat urban/coastal roads rewards steady threshold power. Surging and recovering costs more watts than just holding.
When someone attacks on flat urban/coastal roads, you have 10 seconds to respond or you're off the back. This builds that response.
100 miles rewards fat oxidation. This volume work shifts your fuel mix so you're still burning fat at hour 5, not bonking at hour 3.
88–92% FTP is where you'll spend the hardest sustained miles of Best Buddies Challenge: Miami. Train it until it feels boring.
Long rides with hard efforts mixed in. Simulates what Best Buddies Challenge: Miami's flat urban/coastal roads actually does to you.
At Best Buddies Challenge: Miami, surges push you above threshold and you have to recover while still riding. Over-unders train exactly that.
2-minute all-out efforts on flat urban/coastal roads. Closing gaps, responding to attacks, sprinting for position. Train the burn.
Two threshold sessions per week without the recovery cost of VO2max work. For 100 miles, sustainable FTP gains matter more than peak power.

race_overlay.heat: November in Brickell, Miami, Florida, USA can bring heat. If the forecast warrants it, include controlled heat exposure before Best Buddies Challenge: Miami and rehearse the drinking and electrolyte plan you tolerate in training. Do not introduce a fixed sodium protocol solely from this preview.
race_overlay.nutrition: Target 60–80g carbs/hour for Best Buddies Challenge: Miami’s 100 miles. Start fueling within the first 30 minutes — early fueling prevents late-race collapse. Bonking at mile 60 is a nutrition failure, not a fitness failure.

pack_summary: This 10-workout pack focuses on Durability, Race Simulation, and Road Specific to prepare you for 100 miles of flat urban/coastal roads in Brickell, Miami, Florida, USA.
